name: Nawasena | Survival Mix
description:
🌿 NAWASENA — SURVIVAL MIX 🌿

Looking for a relaxing survival server with meaningful progression and plenty of activities?

Welcome to Nawasena!

Experience survival that still feels like Minecraft, enhanced with quests, unique jobs, player economy, exciting worlds, and Discord Proximity Voice.

✨ MAIN FEATURES ✨

📖 Main Quest & Progression — Follow an exciting journey, complete objectives, and unlock new stages.

📅 Daily Quests — Complete new challenges every day and earn useful rewards.

💼 Unique Custom Jobs — Choose a career with special objectives and its own progression system.

🎙️ Discord Proximity Voice — Talk with nearby players and make every encounter feel more alive.

🛡️ Land Claims — Protect your home, builds, and valuable items.

🏡 Homes & Warps — Save important locations and travel easily.

🌎 Multiple Worlds — Explore Build, Resource, Nether, and The End.

⛏️ Resource World — Gather materials without damaging the main world.

🎲 Random Teleport — Find the perfect place to begin your survival adventure.

💰 Player Economy — Earn money, use shops, and grow your wealth.

🏷️ Auction House — Sell valuable items directly to other players.

🤝 Secure Trading — Trade items and money safely.

🎁 Crates & Rewards — Collect keys and earn exciting prizes.

⚰️ Graves — Keep your items temporarily protected after death.

⭐ Rankup System — Progress from Citizen → Resident → Elder and unlock new perks.

🗳️ Voting Rewards — Support the server and receive rewards.

🏰 Custom Spawn — Access quests, shops, crates, and other facilities.

🔄 Monthly World Resets — Resource, Nether, and The End remain fresh to explore.

🎮 JAVA & BEDROCK CROSSPLAY 🎮

Play together with your friends across different platforms!
